sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000071-P1, was presented by PFIZER (the Supplier) to Highland Pediatric Center 071 on December 17, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession

sections.heading: Supplier Request
